html:
Saigon Midnight Sightseeing Adventure, operated by Vietlook Travel, is a late night city experience designed for international travelers who want to explore Ho Chi Minh City in a calm, atmospheric, and lively setting after dark. When the city cools down and traffic becomes lighter, Saigon reveals a different charm filled with lights, local nightlife, and peaceful streets.

This tour combines iconic landmarks, historical sites, local neighborhoods, night markets, and street food, allowing travelers to see how the city transitions from day to night. It is an ideal choice for visitors who enjoy sightseeing, cultural stories, and local flavors while experiencing the unique energy of Saigon at midnight.

TOUR SCHEDULE

10:00 PM – 02:00 AM

Price: 44 USD per person

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS AND ITINERARY

Ba Son Bridge

Admire Ba Son Bridge, a modern landmark spanning the Saigon River. At night, the bridge offers beautiful views of the city skyline and reflects the rapid urban development of Ho Chi Minh City.

Banh Mi, the World’s Best Sandwich

Stop to enjoy one of the most famous Vietnamese street foods, banh mi. This crispy French style baguette is filled with a variety of meats, fresh vegetables, herbs, and sauces, creating a well balanced and flavorful local favorite.

Thich Quang Duc Monument

Visit the Thich Quang Duc Monument and learn about its historical and cultural significance. Your guide will explain the background of an important event in 1963 related to the Buddhist movement in Vietnam and why this monument remains meaningful today.

Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment and Sugarcane Juice

Explore Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment, one of the oldest apartment complexes in Saigon, built in 1968. Experience the authentic atmosphere of local residential life and enjoy a refreshing glass of freshly pressed sugarcane juice.

Biggest Flower Market in District Ten

Visit the largest flower market in District Ten during its lively night hours. Learn about local customs of buying and using flowers and have the opportunity to create a lotus flower arrangement by yourself. The lotus is the national flower of Vietnam.

Vietnamese Coffee, Smoothie, or Fresh Fruit Juice

Relax at a local shop and choose between Vietnamese coffee, a smoothie, or a freshly prepared fruit juice. This stop offers a chance to enjoy popular local beverages while taking a short break.

Little French Town in the City Center

Walk through an area often referred to as the Little French Town in District One. Discover elegant colonial era architecture, charming streets, and buildings that reflect the lasting French influence on Saigon’s urban design.

Party Street, the Never Sleep Area

End the tour at the famous Party Street, known for its vibrant nightlife. Observe the lively atmosphere filled with bars, restaurants, and music, and experience how Saigon stays active and energetic late into the night.
